tei:div.tei:p: (549)don gsum pa dgag dbye ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la'ang*/

sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug go dang po ni/ dgag dbye'i snga rol zhag bdun tsam nas spyod yul gyi grong du go bar bya ba dang*/ phan tshun 'khon yod na'ang gcig gis gcig la bzod par gsol zhing sbyang bar bya'o// nyer brgyad nyin/ dbyar bdag pa gnyis kyis khur blangs te gtsug lag gi phyag dar dang*/ brgyan dang*/ mchod pa bkod legs pa rgya cher bshams pa rgyas par bya/ rtsa zor ba zhes bya ba ku sha'i chun po rgya gram du bcings ba dge 'dun gyi grangs las brgal ba rnams sta gon du bya'o// dbyar rnyed kyi nang nas dar ram ras sam gang rung zhig dge slong la gcig dang dge tshul rnams la gcig bcas rdzas kyi dgag dbye'i rten du blangs/ de rnams mchod gzhi'i 'gram du shing gi srog ma gnyis sngar tshul shing dus bzhin legs par bkod/ gsung chog gzhan kun dkyus ltar las/ sdom gsum khrid tshab tu yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas sngon du song rjes/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ zhes pa tsam nas dbyar bdag pas gral gsham snam sbyar bcas gding ba bting ste mdo bskul bar bya'o// mkhan pos tshul khrims rnam dag gi mdo bshad pa'am/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo lta bu'am/ yang na mdzangs blun/ dran pa nyer bzhag sogs chos bshad ji ltar 'os pa rgyas bsdus dal khoms skabs dang bstun te byas shing*/ (550) khyim pa sogs kyang nyan par bskul bar bya'o// phyi dro kun dga' ra bar phebs skabs sang gi dgag dbye blo rgyugs dang*/ bkra shis zhal bskor rnams 'di ltar byed ces zhal bgros zhib par gnang*/ de rnams dgag dbye'i sbyor ba rnams so/ / dngos gzhi ni/ nyer dgu'i nang par shin tu snga bar dung dang gaṇḍis bsdus te/ rgyun ltar tshogs nas lha khang du gzhan rnams rang gral dang*/ mkhan po g.yas gral gyi 'gor phebs nas/ thams cad kyis phyag zing zing po ni phan tshun mnyam du 'tshal te gzan gal khyer/ rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas/

dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du tshul bzhin du ma gyur pa thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad bzod par gsol lo// zhes mnyam du brjod/ rang gral du 'khod ma thag ja)btang*/ ltung bshags/ chu gtor/ thub bstod/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ kun mkhyen chos rje bcas bstod pa res bab/ thub chog gnas bcu rnams dang*/ sdom gsum gong 'og gi le tshan/ byams smon bcas zin nas/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas dam can spyi gtor/ gtor bsngo/ bskang ba/ rnam sras bcas/ gter gzhi/ gtor 'gugs zin nas/ las rdor gyis zhwa bzhes/ gtor 'bul la dpal 'bar btsugs pa lag g.yas dang*/ sbreng thur zung*/ phud phor g.yon du thogs nas gtsang sar mchod/ bkra shis yan rdzogs nas/ ja) btang*/ chab bkye bsdu/ snang (551)
